svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · checking · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) in the moment right after a person's Upload (2026-09-26, plan §16 — the second of the two corrections that day: "no ↑ right after an upload"). Every original went up and was confirmed, and PicPlace is still reading them back: the push marks the record (PicPlaceSyncRecord.verifyPendingSince), and while that is inside PicPlaceSyncRecord.verifyWindow the pill's cloud is .checking — so the card, whose glyph is the pill's cloud at rest (statusGlyph(for: .synced) → holdingsPillState(…).cloud), wears the amber ↻ arrow.clockwise.icloud.fill (LL.accent #C36A00 on the light card, the ↻ knocked out in white) instead of the one-to-five minutes of neutral ↑ it used to show beside "Here and on PicPlace". verifyAfterUpload looks at the project every 10 s for two minutes, every 30 s to five, every minute to thirty, whatever the automatic rules; once PicPlace has read the set back the heavy marker is written and the glyph turns to the neutral ✓ (picplace-status.synced). The header is the synced one (title "On PicPlace", the caption "Synced … · records and preview · … · N uploaded" wrapping to two lines at phone width, auto-sync on so no Sync again — as the upload-job siblings); under it the free up space line for the originals, "Here and on PicPlace · 55 files · 209,9 MB" with Remove… (heavyLines → .remove(.originals), heavyAction at 16 × 0.8 = 12.8 pt semibold accent), then the card's small print (notes: Self.removeNote, "You can download the originals and blends again whenever you need them.", wrapping to two lines), then Also on. A Photo capture: no Blends line (a photo's blend is its picture, and travels with the originals). The same moment on a photo is holdings-pill.here.checking. Demo data: the 55-file, 209,9 MB project of the 2026-09-26 review; the header's "118 KB" and "iPad Air" are the sibling set's.
